name: 3D printing
description: Materials (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, nylon, PC, CF, resin), design rules, tolerances and print settings.
instructions: For 3D printing questions: recommend a material with the reason, give print settings (orientation, layer height, walls, infill, supports, temperatures) and design tips (wall thickness, clearances, overhangs). Prefer the easiest material that meets the requirements.
